pairs_touching.what_says_this: group_evidence G0359 (POSSIBLY-RELATION) plus G0918 (STRING-SIMILARITY); both objects small, not truncated. The note describes b as a 'delivered, executed ... pairwise comparison of all nine candidate KnowledgeOS kernels' covering steps 230-236, a superset range of a's steps 230-232 -- and explicitly notes that Step 236 in the primary corpus 'consumes this verification programme's own prior findings verbatim ... attributes them anonymously to the corpus audit,' i.e. b's reconciliation report builds on and extends a's audit findings across a wider step range.
pairs_touching.what_would_make_this_wrong: Wrong if b's 230-236 reconciliation is shown to have been conducted independently of a's 230-232 audit rather than extending its scope.

pairs_touching.notes_for_p3b: CORRECTED during self-check: originally miscoded as relationship=CONTRADICTION (an evidence-kind, not a valid relationship value). Same audit-directly-refutes-specific-claims pattern as RP0229 (canonical-K vs theory-evolution-map), here even more thoroughly evidenced (14 dual-labeled rows, an executed closure test, an executed independence test, and a cross-check against 6 prior kernels). Strongest CONTRADICTION verdict in this batch.
pairs_touching.what_says_this: 14 dual-labeled rows (all S1567, the audit document) directly test and refute B's specific kernel tuple K=(K,C,T,E,A): 'THE DECISIVE RESULT (executed test, rated the single strongest finding)... the kernel is NOT CLOSED -- SS230.10's definition of T requires Policy and tau, but Policy and tau are not kernel components'; an independence-failure test finding 'every one of the kernel's other 4 components (K,C,A,E) appears inside T's own signature'; a Q5 executed test finding Evidence 'double-bound/duplicated' under B's own Model F, typed CONTRADICTION; and a Q9 cross-check finding 6 prior uncited competing kernel proposals, 'all seven kernels remain live and unreconciled.' These are direct, executed (not merely asserted) findings of internal inconsistency in B's specific formal claims, typed EXPERIMENTAL-RESULT/CORRECTION/CONTRADICTION across the full 14-row set. NOTE (self-correction): as with RP0229, the underlying rows are typed CONTRADICTION as a SOURCE-CLAIMED-* evidence kind, not a valid Q1 relationship value under the closed enum {SAME, REFINEMENT, EXTENSION, REDEFINITION, REPLACEMENT, SPECIALIZATION, DERIVED-FROM, CONTINUATION, HOMONYM, INDEPENDENT, UNWITNESSED}. B (the audit) does not claim to be the same concept as, extend, redefine, replace, specialize, derive from, continue, or be a homonym of A (the kernel proposal) -- it tests and refutes A's specific closure/independence/minimality claims. None of the 11 relationship values fits an audit-refutes-specific-claims relationship, so this is correctly UNWITNESSED despite the very strong evidence.
pairs_touching.what_would_make_this_wrong: If a future taxonomy revision adds an 'AUDITS'/'CONTRADICTS' relationship value, this pair (alongside RP0229) would be the strongest candidate for it; absent that, If a later document supplied the missing closure fix (adding Policy/tau to the kernel per the audit's own repair recommendation #1) and demonstrated resulting closure/independence, the CONTRADICTION finding would be resolved/superseded rather than standing.
